text: First run `cb source print` for this project. Then run `ping -n 31 127.0.0.1` in the shell and wait for it to finish (run it in the foreground, not in the background). Then set W2's font size to 321 with `cb source apply`, then immediately read `timeline.tsx` and tell me W2's font size there and whether the clip on the Mine track is muted there.

input.command: mkdir -p .scratch && cb source print 4896fa7c-e7ae-4fe2-9dfe-d3772fd8e2a4 > .scratch/w2.tsx && sed -i '/name="W2"/,/fontSize/ s/fontSize={100}/fontSize={321}/' .scratch/w2.tsx && grep -n "fontSize" .scratch/w2.tsx && cb source apply 4896fa7c-e7ae-4fe2-9dfe-d3772fd8e2a4 .scratch/w2.tsx; echo "---"; grep -n -A8 'name="W2"' timeline.tsx; grep -n -B2 -A10 'name="Mine"' timeline.tsx
input.description: Set W2 font size, apply, then read timeline

blocks.text:
W2's font size is now 321, and the timeline file shows 321 when read right after the change.

The clip on the Mine track (clip.mp4, 0–3s) isn't muted there. It has no mute setting at all. While my turn is running, that file holds back changes from you or teammates, so if someone muted that clip during the wait, the file won't show it until my turn ends.
